stage: Lugano/Ann Arbor stage II bulky disease, with cervical and mediastinal nodal disease above the diaphragm only and a 12 cm mediastinal mass.
biology: Double-expressor lymphoma; not double-hit lymphoma, FISH negative.
prognosis: Use IPI and CNS-IPI. Elevated LDH and bulky disease are adverse.
first_line_treatment: Curative-intent immunochemotherapy with Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles.
cns_risk: Calculate CNS-IPI; prophylaxis individualized based on renal function and fitness.
response_assessment: Use FDG PET-CT with Lugano/Deauville criteria, especially end-of-treatment PET.
missing_information: CSF assessment if CNS staging is pursued
